events.judging.agility: Complete the obstacles in order. Penalties come before time; speed helps when the run stays clean. Categories separate dogs by size.
events.judging.nosework: Find the hidden scent and read your dog’s indication. Fewer mistakes beat a faster search with mistakes.
events.judging.canicross: Manage effort over climbs, turns and the finish. The fastest clean result wins; fatigue carries between sections.
events.judging.conformation: Breed type, structure, movement, presentation and steady behaviour determine the result. Other dogs’ titles do not change this dog’s conformation.
events.judging.progeny: A parent competes with 3–5 direct offspring. The group’s breed type, consistency and offspring achievements determine its result.
events.equipmentRule.agility: Collars and leashes are removed before an agility run. Eligible equipment supports preparation.
events.equipmentRule.nosework: A suitable collar or harness and search leash support the search. Equipment must allow freedom of movement.
events.equipmentRule.canicross: A pulling harness, shock-absorbing tugline and handler belt work during the race. Check the required kit before entering.
events.equipmentRule.conformation: Show equipment supports presentation; it cannot improve inherited anatomy.
events.equipmentRule.progeny: The result belongs to the parent and its offspring group. Equipment does not change the offspring’s inherited qualities.
events.tactic.agility.balanced: Keep a steady pace and control errors.
events.tactic.agility.bold: Gain time at the cost of a higher error risk.
events.tactic.nosework.careful: Recheck signals and avoid false alerts.
events.tactic.nosework.bold: Trust the early signal to save time.
events.tactic.canicross.careful: Preserve stamina for the later sections.
events.tactic.canicross.bold: Attack now and spend your stamina reserve.
events.tactic.conformation.careful: Give the dog time to settle and show calmly.
events.tactic.conformation.bold: Make an expressive show with greater stress risk.
events.tactic.progeny.careful: Present the group calmly and consistently.
events.tactic.progeny.bold: Emphasise standout qualities with greater pressure.
